apply.title: Become an AFC partner
apply.description: Tell us about your organisation and what you want to build. An AFC admin reads every application and replies either way.
apply.doneBody: We have emailed {email} a link you can use to check on it, and to make changes if we ask for any.
apply.doneNote: Keep that email. The link in it is how you reach your application, and it is where your credentials will be waiting if we approve you.

form.sent: Thanks. Your application is with AFC.
form.alreadyPending: You already have an application open with us. We have emailed you the link again.
form.footnote: AFC never asks for a password, and you do not need an AFC account to apply.

errors.redirectRequired: Sign in with AFC needs at least one redirect URI.
errors.generic: Your application could not be sent. Please check the form and try again.

org.title: Your organisation
org.description: Who you are. The display name is what a player sees when they are asked to approve you.
org.name: Organisation name
org.displayNameHint: Leave this blank to use your organisation name.
org.logoHint: Optional. PNG, JPG or WEBP, up to 10 MB. Shown to players when they approve you.

contact.title: Who we talk to
contact.description: One person we can reach about this application.
contact.name: Contact name
contact.emailHint: Every reply goes here, including the link to your credentials. Check it carefully.
contact.whatsappHint: Optional. Include your country code. We may message this number about your application.

technical.title: Sign in with AFC setup
technical.description: The addresses AFC will send players back to. We check these now so you can fix any mistake here rather than at your first sign-in.
technical.redirectHint: One per line. Must be https, except http://localhost for your own machine. No wildcards, no query strings, no fragments. Register production, staging and local separately.
technical.postLogoutHint: Optional. Only if you want to offer players a way to sign out of AFC as well as your site.
technical.webhookHint: Optional. AFC POSTs a signed notice here when a player disconnects you, so you can delete your copy of their data.

about.title: What you are building
about.description: This is what the decision is actually based on, so it is worth a few sentences rather than a few words.
about.useCase: What are you building, and who uses it
about.useCasePlaceholder: For example: a community site where African Free Fire players track their tournament history and compare it with friends.
about.dataNeeded: What do you need from AFC, and why
about.dataNeededPlaceholder: For example: a player's AFC name and their current rank, so we can show it on their profile.
about.dataNeededHint: Describe it in your own words. AFC decides which fields that works out to, and grants the minimum that does the job.

intro.title: Sign in with AFC
intro.description: Let AFC players sign in to your site with their AFC account. Standard OpenID Connect, so you never handle a player's password. Read the guide before you apply if you want to see exactly what is involved.

status.title: Your partner application
status.description: Check where your application stands, and make any changes AFC has asked for.
status.lookupDescription: Use the link in the email AFC sent you, or paste your reference and access code below.
status.notFound: We could not find that application. Check the link in your email.
status.frozen: There is nothing to do right now. We will email you as soon as there is.

explain.pending: An AFC admin has your application and will reply either way. Nothing is needed from you.
explain.changes_requested: AFC has asked for a change. Make it below and send it back, and your application returns to the queue automatically.
explain.approved: You are an AFC partner. Collect your credentials below if you have not already.
explain.rejected: AFC was not able to approve this application. You are welcome to apply again if what we raised changes.

status.alreadyCollected: Your credentials have already been collected. Ask AFC for a new link if you need to reissue them.
status.linkExpired: Your credentials link has expired. Ask AFC to send a new one.
status.editTitle: Make the change AFC asked for
status.editDescription: Edit what needs fixing and send it back. Everything else stays as you wrote it.
status.saveFailed: Your changes could not be saved.

credentials.title: Your AFC credentials
credentials.description: Collect the credentials for your approved partner application.
credentials.collectDescription: Use the link AFC emailed you. If you opened this page some other way, paste your reference and the code from that link.
credentials.beforeYouClick: Your client secret is shown on the next screen once, and never again. This link works one time. Have somewhere safe to paste it before you continue, such as your password manager or your server's secret store.
credentials.failed: Those credentials could not be collected.
credentials.readyBody: Copy these now. Closing this page loses them, and AFC cannot show them to you again.
credentials.clientIdHint: Public. It travels in every sign-in URL, so it is safe to keep in your configuration.
credentials.clientSecretHint: Secret. Keep it on your server only, never in browser code or a public repository.
credentials.apiKeyHint: Secret. Send it as your Data API key header, and keep it on your server only.
credentials.lastWarning: If you lose these, AFC cannot recover them. Ask us for a new link and we will issue fresh ones.
credentials.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.

admin.loadFailed: The applications could not be loaded.
admin.decideFailed: That decision could not be saved.
admin.earlier: {count, plural, one {# earlier application} other {# earlier applications}} from this email address.
admin.editableHint: Prefilled from their application and editable. What you approve here is what goes live, including the name players see on the consent screen.

fields.name: Partner name
fields.displayNameHint: This appears on the consent screen a player reads before trusting them.

admin.grantsSso: What they may see about a player
admin.grantsHint: Every one is off. Grant the minimum that does the job they described.
admin.notePlaceholder: Required when rejecting or asking for changes.
admin.noteHint: This is the whole email they receive, so write it to be read by them.
admin.claimOpen: Their credentials link is live and has not been used yet.
admin.resendHint: Invalidates any earlier link. The secret is only rotated when they open the new one, so if they say the old one still works, nobody opened it.
